value.rationale: MEG-sets are a motivated edge-failure sensing invariant. Exact finite data for the Petersen graph and its two distinguished connected cubic double covers reveals a non-implied discrepancy: on the dodecahedron meg=8 versus vertex-cover number 12, including five independent optimal sensor sets. The full minimal-set polynomials determine the necessary temporary spare capacities 2,3,5 for safe addition/deletion moves; all connectedness thresholds are exact. The comparison gives a natural benchmark and structural contrast, not an arbitrary narrow slice or a supposed all-graphs theorem.
